question: What qualities characterize the being who arises in the east according to this description?
premises: The being arises in the east.
The being inspires fear in all beings.
inference: The being arisen in the east is described as greatly powerful and fearsome to all beings.
uncertainties: The identity of this being is implied as the Vāstunara but not named in this verse.
plain_english: Arisen in the east, he is of great power and brings fear to all beings.
